summary: A complete declarative Swap JSON draft exists and is behaviourally equivalent to the handwritten family on synthetic same-source state: identity (runtime template/immutables/token codes/decimals), both discovery call patterns and the Swapped event, pricing reads and virtual-balance mids/unavailable classification, chain getReturn Exact with the same-source isActive round, quoted/direct-output runtime legs and zero-amount Exact all match the handwritten modules in a 15-check harness. It cannot be delivered in place under this task: (1) the family's own contract test asserts a static plugin.pricing.refreshPolicy === 'each-block' (test/contract.ts:53), but the declarative runtime exposes only refreshPolicyForInstance (declarative-family.ts:483), so rendering the generated entry makes the contract suite 12/13 instead of 13/13; fixing that requires a public TS change (or a test change), both out of scope; (2) a JSON in the family directory cannot be left without the prohibited generator run: build-family-capability-manifest.ts --check fails with 'declarative production entry is missing or stale' (build-declarative-production.ts:497) unless the generated entry and the whole family-capability-shadow.generated.json are regenerated. Minor shape deviations (bindingRef.bindingKey, Exact evidence governance field, extra v2 effect/native measurement) are listed below; they are not protocol-semantics losses but separately prevent byte/evidence-identical replacement. No production entry, public framework TS/test, generated catalog artifact, or live state was changed; the handwritten production entry is restored. A concurrent commit cae1c860 accidentally captured an intermediate copy of this draft at listener/src/searcher/venues/swaps/mooniswap-family/mooniswap.json plus tmp-mooniswap-*.mts harness files; that intermediate copy is invalid (it has standard.identity instead of the required top-level identity.definition and the unfixed poolMaterialization address slice) and this park removes it in favour of the validated draft here.

nonDecisiveGaps.fact: handwritten routes set bindingRef.bindingKey to the per-route routeIdentity string (codec.ts:77-87, routes.ts:9-12); declarative routes take one family-level routes.bindingKey (declarative-family.ts:280) and the projected routeKey is preserved exactly, so bindingKey becomes the lower pool address. Both bindingRef.fingerprint values and both routeKeys match (harness).

handwritten Exact evidence records the mutable governance address (exact.ts:11-15,44-48) and execution requires it (execution.ts:14-16); declarative evidence is evaluated again for the execution fragment without flow evidence (declarative-family.ts:787-798), so a flow-only governance field would make the evidence hash unrecomputable. The draft keeps the same-source isActive round and all other evidence fields but omits `governance`. Using exact.retainReadEvidence would keep it at the cost of carrying readProof instead.

declarative v2 measures the debit/credit deltas on every funded leg and appends an unchanged-native row for ERC20 routes (declarative-execution.ts:463-464); the handwritten default runtime leg is a bare allowance+swapFor (runtime-execution.ts:20-50). This is a stricter check, not a capability loss; quote-output and direct-output capabilities/amounts/receiver/allowance match in the harness.

pricing rows use feePpm = fee / 1e12 (<=0.01 bp truncation) because declarative feeBps rows are integers; mid/depth/reserve values match the handwritten pricing on the synthetic snapshot within that bound.
